title: mos-late-opt dereferences a null tracker on an SPC700 LDImm into an imaginary register
summary: Historical baseline on upstream 06bc967d2668: MOSLateOptimization::combineLdImm selects an A/X/Y tracking slot with a switch over the LDImm destination and then stores through it unconditionally. On SPC700, MOSInstrInfo::getRegClass widens LDImm's destination to Anyi8 to model `mov dp, #imm`, so `$rcN = LDImm imm` is legal, verifier-clean MIR, and the store goes through a null pointer (SIGSEGV). On the recorded upstream main 06bc967d2668 it crashes 31 of the 90 inputs of the series' default-mode set at -mcpu=mosspc700 -O2, 13 of them in-tree CodeGen/MOS tests (fcmp.ll, zp-alloc.ll, light-spill.ll, ...). The tested repair is our upstream PR #584 (restrict the immediate-load folding to GPR destinations), supplied by the October 9 compiler pin f24948c7d1a4 after retiring standalone 0003 and its duplicate aggregate hunk. The initial July-base consolidation retained it in 0002 before the pin advanced; that intermediate result is dated evidence. It is not carried in the #320/#321 split series: the third round briefly carried it as its own commit, and on 2026-10-01 the user decided to sequence it instead (#584 files first). On that pre-merge base, mosspc700 crashes in MOS Late Optimizations identically before and after the series. PR #584 merged October 5 (ce37cddc0c141c52af6fdff6ab6ff5d81e4bf999). The confirmed status describes the immutable captured baseline; this publication refresh does not claim a compiler rebuild or new runtime verification.
attribution: Found in the 138 LZSS far-decode investigation and fixed in PR #584 / patch 0003 (2026-07-31): credits as recorded in the PR commits (Will Norris, co-authored by Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context); agent/tool version and reasoning effort unknown).

Rediscovered as finding N17 by the third independent review of the #320 series: Claude Code 2.1.285, model claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), high reasoning effort; session 310aee67-a99e-4b78-ba48-c560322fe80d.

unknowns: The original July baseline toolchain (the downstream fork at that time) is not preserved here; the 138 plan describes it. This record's baseline is a fresh capture on upstream 06bc967d2668.
Release builds were not examined; the null store is undefined behavior there.

related_changes: round-three split series commit "[MOS] Fix non-GPR immediate loads in mos-late-opt" (#584 squash; dropped in round four)
prior_work.source_assessment: Upstream 06bc967d2668 MOSLateOptimization.cpp combineLdImm has no destination-class filter; #584's net diff adds `!MOS::GPRRegClass.contains(MI.getOperand(0).getReg())` to the existing filtering condition. The #320-2 hunk the review found is the same guard without #584's comment change.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Upstream llc p-321-00 segfaults on #584's own MIR test and on fcmp.ll at mosspc700 -O2; upstream + #584 (r3-584-up) and the series #584 commit pass both. Across 90 inputs x 14 CPUs at -O2, #584 turns exactly the 31 mosspc700 crashes into compiles and changes nothing else.
prior_work.decision: Historical migration: the defect, its fix and its upstream PR exist; only the canonical record was missing. No duplicate upstream submission; the PR gets a prepared follow-up comment with the new measurement.
